defects.observed_behavior: The route transport matrix unit guard failed because web/src/routes/settings/relays/+page.svelte was a live SvelteKit page/loader missing from pstf/features/BAHIA_NOSTR_AUDIT_PARITY/route_transport_matrix.json.
defects.intended_behavior: Every live SvelteKit page/loader has an evidence-backed route transport matrix classification so signer-first REST regression checks remain enforceable.
defects.resolution: Added route_transport_matrix.json classifications for the dedicated /settings/relays route and, because the same guard required it, the concurrently added /settings/profile route without editing those route files.
defects.verification: python3 -m json.tool pstf/features/BAHIA_NOSTR_AUDIT_PARITY/route_transport_matrix.json and npm --prefix web run test:unit -- --run tests/unit/route-transport-matrix.test.js passed on 2026-06-07.
defects.scope_note: Discovered during Bead bahia-1ywi verification; separate from relay sidecar HTTP surface documentation acceptance criteria. /settings/profile source files were not edited; only route matrix classification was added because the guard requires every live page to be classified.
